decision_notes: The affected vulnerability range and the assessed static Trigger rule both cover <2.32.4. Upstream advisory, historical source, fix PR/commit, and public security discussion support the host-confusion URL semantics. The supported positional_url_condition statically recognizes a literal URL whose legacy netloc-derived .netrc lookup host differs from the parsed hostname. Positive and negative controlled regressions preserve the same version-exposure context while distinguishing crafted and ordinary URL structures. Environment and runtime preconditions, including .netrc credential availability, trust_env state, attacker-controlled input, and redirect behavior, are not asserted as statically satisfied. Therefore an eligible rule match is semantic evidence only and does not prove actual credential exposure or exploitability.
